For the mapped KiTS cases, AbdomenAtlas 3.0's largest kidney lesion diameter agrees with KiTS23's radiographic_size. explanation: The ID mapping published with DeepTumorVQA (GitHub, branch v1) gives the source scan of each BDMAP ID. It names 300 KiTS21 scans and 189 KiTS23 scans, which together are the 489 KiTS23 training cases. Another 176 BDMAP IDs map to KiTS19-21 names with case numbers from the same range. The metadata tables give them the same shape, spacing (up to axis order) and kidney lesion size as the KiTS21 row with that number. They therefore look like second copies of the same scans. In total, 665 BDMAP IDs hold 489 KiTS cases. These patients are counted in both releases, so the counts must not be added.
